_comment_operator_01: The account to add in the bubble. Once the bubble is started, we wait this account until it joins the conf. Then we add phone numbers
_comment_operator_02: id, and/or jid and/or login can be set here (this order is used to get the associated account)
_comment_phoneNumbers: List of phone numbers to add as participants once the conference has started and when the operator has joined
_comment_maxPhoneNumberToAddInFirstRow: Max number of phone numbers to add in one row the first time. Then they are added one by one (if any)
_comment_addNewPhoneNumberWhen_01: To know when to add a new phone number after the first row when we received event info about a previous phone number
_comment_addNewPhoneNumberWhen_02: Possible values are: active, ringing, progress
